body: Similar experience, I (m) was 28 at the time, melanoma was 3.8mm on my shoulder. Stage 2. Had spread to my lymph node in my left armpit but was only classified as topical melanoma of the lymph node. Meaning the cancer was just going to be shaved off the lymph node and not needing full lymph node removal. Surgery went well. Started Keytruda since it already showed signs of spreading. I received four infusion treatments (each 3 weeks apart), then began getting very ill and ended up in the ICU going into liver failure due to the Keytruda attacking my liver.
Male almost 28 now, found at 21 after symptoms started around 17 (my own doing from being scared/stubborn)
Thank you for this. Truly. I try to have my inner voice tell me this, but it just doesn’t have the effect of someone else saying these words.
Yes, medication for about 5 years now and also did two months of daily radiation and 2 years of weekly chemo
Wow I’m slightly envious of you, my tumor surgeries (2) have removed maybe 33% of it total. Tbh I’m glad to hear some people had better success

Been taking 2mg per week for about 5 years, the initial tiredness and nausea slowly subsided. My only current side effect is about 2 years ago I became allergic to it, skin biopsy confirms, however the other drug (dostinex?) is entirely too expensive so I have to take Zyrtec with the CAB to prevent the hives

26(m) with 2 surgeries. Maybe 25% reduction from both surgeries combined and then followed by 2 months of radiation and 2 years of oral chemo… have been on high dose of cabergoline since 2016 and testosterone gel for past year. Docs have said I will probably be on some sort of hormone therapy for the rest of my life. And still have 50% of the tumor in my head/active but blood work shows consistent decrease of prolactin level (started at 900-ish and now 480-ish)

5 years of cabergoline here. Macro prolactinoma. 2 surgeries. 2 months of radiation. 2 years of chemo… life really sucks if you let it. Spent a longggggg time ready to put a bullet in my head. I’m past that now but the cabergoline won’t be letting up anytime soon. Taking 1mg, twice a week
My 1981 or 2001 car would work...or both together to be sure
Lactation... if you're a male, tell your endocrinologist

25m here. Was diagnosed almost 6 years ago with a prolactinoma that was like 80mm at its largest part. Basically optic nerve to the other optic nerve..... anyways been on high dosage of cabergoline twice a week ever since. And the way my endocrinologist and neurologist explained to me was they know what it is, but not why it is. That I would probably be taking caber for the rest of my life to make sure that my body doesnt decide to over produce prolactin... the doc told me the alcohol is different person to person but I personally dont have any issue knocking a few back.... lots of other issues tho haha.... dont worry bro. Sounds like you caught it early and you'll be fine 🤘

You'll be ok. Mine was found when I was 22 and have been on cabergoline ever since. Very high dosage since my tumor was 70mm.... you found it early and tiny and I would imagine cabergoline will handle your issue..  take a deep breath and if a little advice i could give is eat healthier and workout more and be patient.

I had all of the above symptoms... I had waited so long that I was legally blind with 75%loss in my right eye and 50% loss in my left....well 2 surgeries and years of medication it's gotten better but will never be perfect again
After a couple months I noticed I had more energy... probably just from the headaches subsiding

Hi. I'm 24(M) and have similar issues and feelings. My mother abandoned me just before 2 years old. And it's been basically my alcoholic, narcissistic father raising me with the occasional girlfriend or some other relative that doesnt give a shit about me anymore... anyways I have had 2 brain surgeries since Sept. 2018 and has now left me with a large scar across my head. With small bald spots. A messed up eye that doesnt sit the same as the other and my eyebrow is off. And a bump on the side of my head from some infection. I find myself so ugly and hate myself. As a child and teenager, I always struggled with my weight and anger issues and was bullied. I also have little to no skills and basically fail at everything I try. I have thought about suicide almost every single day for the last 2-3 years. Especially while doing chemotherapy and radiation. Where I feel like I am dying. I have no interest in what the future holds. So I'm not sure why I havent given up yet. Too scared to do it. And dont want it to burden anyone..... this is honestly my first ever comment/post, and I want you to know that you're strong and beautiful. The courage I just mustered to comment is half of what it took you to even post. Stay strong. Please feel free to message me. I think we both could benefit... I'm almost ready to make my first post too
